metadata.title: Capivasertib and Fulvestrant Therapy
metadata.indication: Adults with ER-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced/metastatic breast cancer with one or more PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN alterations after recurrence/progression on or after an endocrine-based regimen.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled encoding; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

source_boundaries: Hyperglycaemia uses CTCAEv4.03 numeric fasting-glucose bands; diarrhoea/rash/other toxicities usev5.0.
Fulvestrant Child-PughB recommendation differs between NCCP00947 Table3 and EMA Faslodex; no definitive dose is calculated.
NCCP combination severe-renal exclusion takes precedence over a fulvestrant-only component-table statement.
Grade2 diarrhoea interruption and recurrent grade3 rash discontinuation are clinician decisions.
Current dose and time-to-recovery history are required before selecting a restart; source ladder ends at200mg twice daily.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Feasibility decision-support encoding; independent clinical and oncology-pharmacy validation pending. Confirm current NCCP/SmPC, prescribing review and local policy. Source conflicts require specialist reconciliation.

indications.description: Adults with ER-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced/metastatic breast cancer with one or more PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN alterations after recurrence/progression on or after an endocrine-based regimen.

treatment.schedule_summary: Capivasertib400mg twice daily onDays1–4,8–11,15–18,22–25 of each28-day cycle; fulvestrant500mg IM onDays1/15 of cycle1 thenDay1 of each later cycle.

administration.notes: Approximately12hours apart; four days on then three days off every week. With/without food; tablets whole. Dose reductions320 then200mg twice daily preserve the same on/off pattern.
Two5mL injections, one per buttock,1–2minutes each. Cycle1 includes the extraDay15 loading dose; from cycle2Day1 only. Not an IV infusion.

treatment_phases.label: Cycle2 onward: capivasertib plus fulvestrant every28days

administration.notes: Approximately12hours apart; four days on then three days off every week. With/without food; tablets whole. Dose reductions320 then200mg twice daily preserve the same on/off pattern.
Two5mL injections, one per buttock,1–2minutes each. Cycle1 includes the extraDay15 loading dose; from cycle2Day1 only. Not an IV infusion.

akt_pathway_alteration.label: Validated tumour PIK3CA / AKT1 / PTEN result

options.label: At least one qualifying alteration confirmed

prior_endocrine_progression.label: Recurrence/progression on or after an endocrine-based regimen confirmed

lhrh_plan_confirmed.label: LHRH agonist plan confirmed when required / considered

hypersensitivity.label: Hypersensitivity to capivasertib, fulvestrant or excipients

pretreatment_tests_unresolved.label: Due baseline/cycle tests or eligibility checks unresolved

bleeding_risk.label: Bleeding diathesis, thrombocytopenia or anticoagulant treatment

new_injection_neurologic_symptoms.label: Severe injection pain, sciatica or new neurological symptoms

renal_input.source_basis: EMA Truqap 5.2 defines severe impairment CrCl<30; NCCP00947 excludes severe renal impairment. Preserve fulvestrant component-table limitation separately.

glucose_not_fasting_predose.label: Entered glucose is not confirmed as fasting/pre-dose

type1_or_insulin_dependent_diabetes.label: Type 1 diabetes or Type 2 diabetes requiring insulin

dka_risk_factors.label: Additional DKA risks, e.g. infection, sepsis, regular systemic steroids, dehydration

hyperglycaemia_symptoms.label: New excessive thirst/polyuria, increased appetite with weight loss or other concerning glucose symptoms

glucose_event_peak_grade.label: Peak grade of the hyperglycaemia event being reviewed

glucose_recovery_days.label: Days from interruption to FG ≤8.9 mmol/L

glucose_interruption_days.label: Completed days since interruption for this glucose event

g4_confirmed_persistent_after24h.label: FG >27.8 mmol/L confirmed after 24 hours during the grade 4 event

metformin_started_or_used.label: Metformin is prescribed / being started with capivasertib

hypoglycaemia_concern.label: Possible hypoglycaemia, especially on capivasertib-free days

further_reduction_at200.label: Further dose reduction needed despite 200 mg twice daily

narrow_therapeutic_index_interaction.label: Potential narrow-therapeutic-index CYP3A/CYP2D6/CYP2B6 or UGT interaction

diarrhoea_grade.label: Current diarrhoea grade
diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade the named adverse event using CTCAE v5.0. Hyperglycaemia uses the separate fasting-glucose table (CTCAE v4.03), not this grade field.

rash_grade.label: Current rash / skin-drug reaction grade
rash_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade the named adverse event using CTCAE v5.0. Hyperglycaemia uses the separate fasting-glucose table (CTCAE v4.03), not this grade field.

other_toxicity_grade.label: Other toxicity grade (exclude glucose, diarrhoea and rash)
other_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade the named adverse event using CTCAE v5.0. Hyperglycaemia uses the separate fasting-glucose table (CTCAE v4.03), not this grade field.

diarrhoea_event_peak_grade.label: Peak grade of the diarrhoea event being reviewed

diarrhoea_recovery_days.label: Days from interruption to diarrhoea grade ≤1

diarrhoea_interruption_days.label: Completed days since interruption for diarrhoea

rash_event_peak_grade.label: Peak grade of the rash / skin-drug reaction event being reviewed

rash_recovery_days.label: Days from interruption to rash / skin-drug reaction grade ≤1

rash_interruption_days.label: Completed days since interruption for rash / skin-drug reaction

other_event_peak_grade.label: Peak grade of the other toxicity event being reviewed

diarrhoea_complication.label: Dehydration, hypokalaemia, kidney injury or arrhythmia with diarrhoea

rash_not_improved_with_treatment.label: Grade 2 rash not improving with treatment

rash_clinically_tolerable.label: Previously held grade 2 rash is now clinically tolerable

serious_skin_reaction.label: Blistering, mucosal lesions, peeling or suspected severe skin-drug reaction

oral_onj_symptoms.label: New/worsening dental or jaw symptoms suggesting ONJ

estradiol_result_unexpected.label: Unexpected estradiol immunoassay result during fulvestrant treatment

fasting_glucose_above_uln.label: Fasting glucose is above the laboratory ULN

action.message: This regimen is for locally advanced/metastatic disease; confirm the treatment setting.

rules.explanation: This regimen is for locally advanced/metastatic disease; confirm the treatment setting.

action.message: ER-positive disease is required; confirm the receptor result.

rules.explanation: ER-positive disease is required; confirm the receptor result.

action.message: HER2-negative disease is required; confirm the receptor result.

rules.explanation: HER2-negative disease is required; confirm the receptor result.

action.message: A qualifying PIK3CA, AKT1 or PTEN alteration must be confirmed using a validated test; do not infer eligibility from ER/HER2 alone.

rules.explanation: A qualifying PIK3CA, AKT1 or PTEN alteration must be confirmed using a validated test; do not infer eligibility from ER/HER2 alone.

action.message: The source indication requires recurrence or progression on or after an endocrine-based regimen. Confirm prior endocrine treatment and progression before use.

rules.explanation: The source indication requires recurrence or progression on or after an endocrine-based regimen. Confirm prior endocrine treatment and progression before use.

action.message: Pre-/perimenopausal women require an LHRH agonist with this combination. Confirm the ovarian-suppression plan; amenorrhoea alone does not establish menopause.

rules.explanation: Pre-/perimenopausal women require an LHRH agonist with this combination. Confirm the ovarian-suppression plan; amenorrhoea alone does not establish menopause.

action.message: For men, consider an LHRH agonist according to current clinical practice; confirm the plan rather than treating this as an automatic mandatory-dose rule.

rules.explanation: For men, consider an LHRH agonist according to current clinical practice; confirm the plan rather than treating this as an automatic mandatory-dose rule.

action.message: Clarify menopausal/gonadal context and whether ovarian suppression is required.

rules.explanation: Clarify menopausal/gonadal context and whether ovarian suppression is required.

action.message: ECOG above 2 is outside the stated NCCP eligibility; obtain Consultant review.

rules.explanation: ECOG above 2 is outside the stated NCCP eligibility; obtain Consultant review.

action.message: The source indication is adult treatment; safety and efficacy under 18 years are not established.

rules.explanation: The source indication is adult treatment; safety and efficacy under 18 years are not established.

action.message: Hypersensitivity to either agent or excipients is an NCCP exclusion.

rules.explanation: Hypersensitivity to either agent or excipients is an NCCP exclusion.

action.message: Pregnancy is an NCCP exclusion; do not administer the combination.

rules.explanation: Pregnancy is an NCCP exclusion; do not administer the combination.

action.message: Breastfeeding is an NCCP exclusion; do not administer the combination.

rules.explanation: Breastfeeding is an NCCP exclusion; do not administer the combination.

action.message: Severe hepatic impairment is an NCCP exclusion; fulvestrant is contraindicated and capivasertib not recommended.

rules.explanation: Severe hepatic impairment is an NCCP exclusion; fulvestrant is contraindicated and capivasertib not recommended.

action.message: Severe renal impairment is an NCCP combination exclusion. The fulvestrant component table does not override the capivasertib restriction.

rules.explanation: Severe renal impairment is an NCCP combination exclusion. The fulvestrant component table does not override the capivasertib restriction.

action.message: Resolve the due tests and eligibility checks before a treatment decision; missing results are not assumed normal.

rules.explanation: Resolve the due tests and eligibility checks before a treatment decision; missing results are not assumed normal.

action.message: Confirm creatinine clearance before applying the numeric CrCl boundary. An indexed eGFR is not automatically interchangeable with CrCl.

rules.explanation: Confirm creatinine clearance before applying the numeric CrCl boundary. An indexed eGFR is not automatically interchangeable with CrCl.

action.message: CrCl <30 mL/min meets the EMA severe-renal category; NCCP excludes severe renal impairment for this combination. Fulvestrant Table 3 expects no adjustment, while its EMA SmPC advises caution: neither clears capivasertib or the full combination.

rules.explanation: CrCl <30 mL/min meets the EMA severe-renal category; NCCP excludes severe renal impairment for this combination. Fulvestrant Table 3 expects no adjustment, while its EMA SmPC advises caution: neither clears capivasertib or the full combination.

action.message: Do not use the combination routinely in haemodialysis: capivasertib severe-renal evidence is absent and the NCCP severe-renal exclusion applies. Fulvestrant-only decisions require a separately reviewed plan.

rules.explanation: Do not use the combination routinely in haemodialysis: capivasertib severe-renal evidence is absent and the NCCP severe-renal exclusion applies. Fulvestrant-only decisions require a separately reviewed plan.

action.message: Capivasertib moderate hepatic impairment: limited data; use only if benefit outweighs risk and monitor closely. No numeric reduction is specified.

rules.explanation: Capivasertib moderate hepatic impairment: limited data; use only if benefit outweighs risk and monitor closely. No numeric reduction is specified.

action.message: Severe hepatic impairment: capivasertib is not recommended and the NCCP combination is excluded.

rules.explanation: Severe hepatic impairment: capivasertib is not recommended and the NCCP combination is excluded.

action.message: Fulvestrant source conflict: NCCP00947 Table 3 (Giraud) recommends 50% of original dose (250 mg) for Child-Pugh B; EMA Faslodex recommends no dose adjustment in mild/moderate impairment with caution. Consultant/pharmacy reconciliation is required; no definitive dose is calculated.

rules.explanation: Fulvestrant source conflict: NCCP00947 Table 3 (Giraud) recommends 50% of original dose (250 mg) for Child-Pugh B; EMA Faslodex recommends no dose adjustment in mild/moderate impairment with caution. Consultant/pharmacy reconciliation is required; no definitive dose is calculated.

action.message: Child-Pugh C/severe hepatic impairment: fulvestrant is not recommended in NCCP and contraindicated in EMA; do not administer the combination.

rules.explanation: Child-Pugh C/severe hepatic impairment: fulvestrant is not recommended in NCCP and contraindicated in EMA; do not administer the combination.

action.message: Clarify the hepatic impairment category before a component dose decision.

rules.explanation: Clarify the hepatic impairment category before a component dose decision.

action.message: Clarify the hepatic impairment category before a component dose decision.

rules.explanation: Clarify the hepatic impairment category before a component dose decision.

action.message: Day 1 requires ANC ≥1.0 ×10⁹/L for fulvestrant IM-injection safety; below this discuss with Consultant. This is not a capivasertib myelosuppression reduction rule. Confirm the treatment day and injection plan.

rules.explanation: Day 1 requires ANC ≥1.0 ×10⁹/L for fulvestrant IM-injection safety; below this discuss with Consultant. This is not a capivasertib myelosuppression reduction rule. Confirm the treatment day and injection plan.

action.message: Day 1 requires platelets ≥100 ×10⁹/L for fulvestrant IM-injection safety; below this discuss with Consultant. Do not impose an automatic capivasertib dose reduction.

rules.explanation: Day 1 requires platelets ≥100 ×10⁹/L for fulvestrant IM-injection safety; below this discuss with Consultant. Do not impose an automatic capivasertib dose reduction.

action.message: Fulvestrant IM injections require caution with bleeding diathesis, thrombocytopenia or anticoagulants. Assess bleeding risk and injection plan; no universal dose adjustment is specified.

rules.explanation: Fulvestrant IM injections require caution with bleeding diathesis, thrombocytopenia or anticoagulants. Assess bleeding risk and injection plan; no universal dose adjustment is specified.

action.message: Promptly assess severe gluteal pain, sciatica or new neurological symptoms before further fulvestrant injection; consider injection-site nerve injury.

rules.explanation: Promptly assess severe gluteal pain, sciatica or new neurological symptoms before further fulvestrant injection; consider injection-site nerve injury.

action.message: Confirmed DKA: permanently discontinue capivasertib and provide emergency metabolic treatment. This does not automatically permanently discontinue fulvestrant.

rules.explanation: Confirmed DKA: permanently discontinue capivasertib and provide emergency metabolic treatment. This does not automatically permanently discontinue fulvestrant.

action.message: Suspected DKA: interrupt capivasertib immediately and arrange urgent emergency assessment, blood ketones and metabolic evaluation. Do not wait for an extreme glucose value; DKA can occur at any time.

rules.explanation: Suspected DKA: interrupt capivasertib immediately and arrange urgent emergency assessment, blood ketones and metabolic evaluation. Do not wait for an extreme glucose value; DKA can occur at any time.

action.message: Urgently assess new hyperglycaemia symptoms and check glucose, ketones and metabolic status as indicated. Additional vomiting, abdominal pain, breathing difficulty, fruity breath, confusion or somnolence may indicate DKA and require immediate capivasertib interruption and emergency assessment.

rules.explanation: Urgently assess new hyperglycaemia symptoms and check glucose, ketones and metabolic status as indicated. Additional vomiting, abdominal pain, breathing difficulty, fruity breath, confusion or somnolence may indicate DKA and require immediate capivasertib interruption and emergency assessment.

action.message: The capivasertib glucose dose table uses fasting glucose before dosing. Verify sampling; do not interpret a random value as a definitive source grade. Marked hyperglycaemia or DKA symptoms still require urgent clinical assessment.

rules.explanation: The capivasertib glucose dose table uses fasting glucose before dosing. Verify sampling; do not interpret a random value as a definitive source grade. Marked hyperglycaemia or DKA symptoms still require urgent clinical assessment.

action.message: Withhold capivasertib for fasting glucose >8.9 to 13.9 mmol/L; initiate/intensify anti-diabetic therapy and assess ketones/metabolic status as indicated.

rules.explanation: Withhold capivasertib for fasting glucose >8.9 to 13.9 mmol/L; initiate/intensify anti-diabetic therapy and assess ketones/metabolic status as indicated.

action.message: Withhold capivasertib for fasting glucose >13.9 to 27.8 mmol/L and consult a diabetologist. Intensify glucose treatment; consider insulin/hydration as indicated, with ketone/metabolic assessment.

rules.explanation: Withhold capivasertib for fasting glucose >13.9 to 27.8 mmol/L and consult a diabetologist. Intensify glucose treatment; consider insulin/hydration as indicated, with ketone/metabolic assessment.

action.message: Withhold capivasertib for fasting glucose >27.8 mmol/L and arrange urgent diabetologist/metabolic management. Reassess within 24 hours; confirmed persistence above27.8 after 24 hours requires permanent discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Withhold capivasertib for fasting glucose >27.8 mmol/L and arrange urgent diabetologist/metabolic management. Reassess within 24 hours; confirmed persistence above27.8 after 24 hours requires permanent discontinuation.

action.message: Fasting glucose above the laboratory ULN and ≤8.9 mmol/L: the source specifies no capivasertib adjustment; consider initiating/intensifying oral glucose treatment and monitoring. This assesses only the entered glucose domain.

rules.explanation: Fasting glucose above the laboratory ULN and ≤8.9 mmol/L: the source specifies no capivasertib adjustment; consider initiating/intensifying oral glucose treatment and monitoring. This assesses only the entered glucose domain.

action.message: Fasting glucose confirmed >27.8 mmol/L after 24 hours during the grade 4 event: permanently discontinue capivasertib. A later lower reading does not erase the confirmed cessation criterion.

rules.explanation: Fasting glucose confirmed >27.8 mmol/L after 24 hours during the grade 4 event: permanently discontinue capivasertib. A later lower reading does not erase the confirmed cessation criterion.

action.message: Hyperglycaemia restart review needs the current fasting glucose and event course. Do not restart from a prior grade alone.

rules.explanation: Hyperglycaemia restart review needs the current fasting glucose and event course. Do not restart from a prior grade alone.

action.message: Hyperglycaemia restart review needs the current fasting glucose and event course. Do not restart from a prior grade alone.

rules.explanation: Hyperglycaemia restart review needs the current fasting glucose and event course. Do not restart from a prior grade alone.

action.message: Hyperglycaemia restart review needs the current fasting glucose and event course. Do not restart from a prior grade alone.

rules.explanation: Hyperglycaemia restart review needs the current fasting glucose and event course. Do not restart from a prior grade alone.

action.message: Current fasting glucose is ≤8.9 mmol/L but time to recovery is missing. Establish whether the target was reached within 28 days before selecting the restart action.

rules.explanation: Current fasting glucose is ≤8.9 mmol/L but time to recovery is missing. Establish whether the target was reached within 28 days before selecting the restart action.

action.message: After grade 2 hyperglycaemia with FG recovery to≤8.9 within 28 days, the source permits restart at the same pre-interruption dose level with maintained glucose treatment. Confirm actual dose, concurrent interactions and all other domains.

rules.explanation: After grade 2 hyperglycaemia with FG recovery to≤8.9 within 28 days, the source permits restart at the same pre-interruption dose level with maintained glucose treatment. Confirm actual dose, concurrent interactions and all other domains.

action.message: After grade 2 hyperglycaemia with FG recovery to≤8.9 after 28 days, restart is at one lower dose level, subject to Consultant confirmation and the current dose ladder (400→320→200 mg twice daily). Do not calculate a dose without history.

rules.explanation: After grade 2 hyperglycaemia with FG recovery to≤8.9 after 28 days, restart is at one lower dose level, subject to Consultant confirmation and the current dose ladder (400→320→200 mg twice daily). Do not calculate a dose without history.

action.message: After grade 3 hyperglycaemia with FG recovery to≤8.9 within 28 days, restart at one lower dose level with maintained glucose treatment, after Consultant reconciliation of the current dose and other domains.

rules.explanation: After grade 3 hyperglycaemia with FG recovery to≤8.9 within 28 days, restart at one lower dose level with maintained glucose treatment, after Consultant reconciliation of the current dose and other domains.

action.message: Grade 3 hyperglycaemia has not recovered to FG≤8.9 mmol/L within 28 days despite appropriate treatment: permanently discontinue capivasertib.

rules.explanation: Grade 3 hyperglycaemia has not recovered to FG≤8.9 mmol/L within 28 days despite appropriate treatment: permanently discontinue capivasertib.

action.message: Grade 3 glucose recovery occurred only after 28 days: the source requires permanent capivasertib discontinuation when FG does not reach≤8.9 within 28 days.

rules.explanation: Grade 3 glucose recovery occurred only after 28 days: the source requires permanent capivasertib discontinuation when FG does not reach≤8.9 within 28 days.

action.message: After a grade 4 glucose event, confirm whether FG fell to≤27.8 within 24 hours and apply the current grade pathway. A lower later reading alone does not establish timely recovery or a safe restart; obtain diabetologist/Consultant review.

rules.explanation: After a grade 4 glucose event, confirm whether FG fell to≤27.8 within 24 hours and apply the current grade pathway. A lower later reading alone does not establish timely recovery or a safe restart; obtain diabetologist/Consultant review.

action.message: EMA notes Type1 diabetes or Type2 diabetes requiring insulin was not studied in CAPItello291. Obtain individual diabetology/Consultant review; this is an evidence limitation, not an invented absolute NCCP exclusion.

rules.explanation: EMA notes Type1 diabetes or Type2 diabetes requiring insulin was not studied in CAPItello291. Obtain individual diabetology/Consultant review; this is an evidence limitation, not an invented absolute NCCP exclusion.

action.message: Optimise glycaemia and agree intensified monitoring. Diabetes requires daily fasting-glucose self-monitoring for the first2 weeks; add HbA1c atweek4 for diabetes/pre-diabetes/baseline hyperglycaemia.

rules.explanation: Optimise glycaemia and agree intensified monitoring. Diabetes requires daily fasting-glucose self-monitoring for the first2 weeks; add HbA1c atweek4 for diabetes/pre-diabetes/baseline hyperglycaemia.

action.message: Increase glucose/ketone vigilance for additional DKA risks including infection, steroids, dehydration and sepsis; tailor monitoring with the treating team.

rules.explanation: Increase glucose/ketone vigilance for additional DKA risks including infection, steroids, dehydration and sepsis; tailor monitoring with the treating team.

action.message: HbA1c >8% was excluded from the pivotal study and capivasertib safety/efficacy is unstudied in this group. Optimise glycaemia with specialist review; HbA1c is not interchangeable with the current fasting-glucose hold table.

rules.explanation: HbA1c >8% was excluded from the pivotal study and capivasertib safety/efficacy is unstudied in this group. Optimise glycaemia with specialist review; HbA1c is not interchangeable with the current fasting-glucose hold table.

action.message: Agree an individual diabetes prescription. NCCP Table 4 footnote recommends metformin on capivasertib dosing days and withdrawal with capivasertib unless otherwise clinically indicated; do not automatically stop pre-existing diabetes treatment. Check creatinine weekly for up to 3 weeks after metformin initiation, then each cycle Day 1, and address off-day hypoglycaemia risk.

rules.explanation: Agree an individual diabetes prescription. NCCP Table 4 footnote recommends metformin on capivasertib dosing days and withdrawal with capivasertib unless otherwise clinically indicated; do not automatically stop pre-existing diabetes treatment. Check creatinine weekly for up to 3 weeks after metformin initiation, then each cycle Day 1, and address off-day hypoglycaemia risk.

action.message: Promptly assess possible hypoglycaemia and review anti-diabetic therapy, particularly on capivasertib-free days. Use the individual diabetes plan; do not prescribe a generic adjustment.

rules.explanation: Promptly assess possible hypoglycaemia and review anti-diabetic therapy, particularly on capivasertib-free days. Use the individual diabetes plan; do not prescribe a generic adjustment.

action.message: Grade 1 diarrhoea: source requires supportive care/anti-diarrhoeal treatment and monitoring, with no capivasertib adjustment. Start the agreed diarrhoea plan promptly and maintain hydration.

rules.explanation: Grade 1 diarrhoea: source requires supportive care/anti-diarrhoeal treatment and monitoring, with no capivasertib adjustment. Start the agreed diarrhoea plan promptly and maintain hydration.

action.message: Grade 2 diarrhoea: initiate/intensify treatment; interruption for up to 28 days is considered if clinically indicated rather than automatic. After recovery tograde≤1, same or one lower level may be selected. Persistent/recurrent grade 2 favours next lower level as clinically indicated.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 diarrhoea: initiate/intensify treatment; interruption for up to 28 days is considered if clinically indicated rather than automatic. After recovery tograde≤1, same or one lower level may be selected. Persistent/recurrent grade 2 favours next lower level as clinically indicated.

action.message: Grade 3 diarrhoea: interrupt capivasertib; treat diarrhoea, hydration and electrolytes. Recovery tograde≤1 within 28 days permits one-level-lower restart; failure to recover requires permanent discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Grade 3 diarrhoea: interrupt capivasertib; treat diarrhoea, hydration and electrolytes. Recovery tograde≤1 within 28 days permits one-level-lower restart; failure to recover requires permanent discontinuation.

action.message: Grade 4 diarrhoea: permanently discontinue capivasertib.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 diarrhoea: permanently discontinue capivasertib.

action.message: Persistent/recurrent grade 2 diarrhoea: maintain medical treatment and consider restarting at the next lower current capivasertib dose after recovery; consider secondary prophylaxis. Confirm the event grade and dose history.

rules.explanation: Persistent/recurrent grade 2 diarrhoea: maintain medical treatment and consider restarting at the next lower current capivasertib dose after recovery; consider secondary prophylaxis. Confirm the event grade and dose history.

action.message: After grade 2 diarrhoea recovers tograde≤1, the source permits same or one lower capivasertib dose as clinically indicated; persistent/recurrent grade 2 favours the next lower current level. Confirm current dose and the clinical plan.

rules.explanation: After grade 2 diarrhoea recovers tograde≤1, the source permits same or one lower capivasertib dose as clinically indicated; persistent/recurrent grade 2 favours the next lower current level. Confirm current dose and the clinical plan.

action.message: Grade 2 diarrhoea interruption exceeds the source wording of up to 28 days. Obtain Consultant review rather than inventing a permanent-stop rule or automatically restarting.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 diarrhoea interruption exceeds the source wording of up to 28 days. Obtain Consultant review rather than inventing a permanent-stop rule or automatically restarting.

action.message: Diarrhoea with dehydration, hypokalaemia, kidney injury or arrhythmia requires urgent clinical assessment and treatment interruption pending review. Correct volume/electrolyte problems and apply the confirmed event-grade pathway.

rules.explanation: Diarrhoea with dehydration, hypokalaemia, kidney injury or arrhythmia requires urgent clinical assessment and treatment interruption pending review. Correct volume/electrolyte problems and apply the confirmed event-grade pathway.

action.message: Grade 1 rash: emollients and consider non-sedating antihistamine; no capivasertib adjustment is specified. Consider dermatology review for every grade.

rules.explanation: Grade 1 rash: emollients and consider non-sedating antihistamine; no capivasertib adjustment is specified. Consider dermatology review for every grade.

action.message: Grade 2 rash: topical steroids and consider non-sedating antihistamine. Interrupt if not improving with treatment; restart at the same dose when clinically tolerable. Confirm response to treatment rather than automatically interrupting all grade 2 rash.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 rash: topical steroids and consider non-sedating antihistamine. Interrupt if not improving with treatment; restart at the same dose when clinically tolerable. Confirm response to treatment rather than automatically interrupting all grade 2 rash.

action.message: Grade 2 rash not improving with treatment: interrupt capivasertib. Same-level restart is only considered when clinically tolerable.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 rash not improving with treatment: interrupt capivasertib. Same-level restart is only considered when clinically tolerable.

action.message: Previously held grade 2 rash is now clinically tolerable: the source permits same-level capivasertib restart after Consultant review; reconcile current severity and dose history.

rules.explanation: Previously held grade 2 rash is now clinically tolerable: the source permits same-level capivasertib restart after Consultant review; reconcile current severity and dose history.

action.message: Before a same-level restart after held grade 2 rash, confirm that the rash is clinically tolerable. A missing tolerance assessment is not recovery.

rules.explanation: Before a same-level restart after held grade 2 rash, confirm that the rash is clinically tolerable. A missing tolerance assessment is not recovery.

action.message: Grade 3 skin-drug reaction: interrupt capivasertib and initiate appropriate dermatological treatment. Recovery tograde≤1 within 28 days permits a one-level-lower restart; if not recovered within 28 days discontinue.

rules.explanation: Grade 3 skin-drug reaction: interrupt capivasertib and initiate appropriate dermatological treatment. Recovery tograde≤1 within 28 days permits a one-level-lower restart; if not recovered within 28 days discontinue.

action.message: Grade 4 rash/skin-drug reaction: permanently discontinue capivasertib.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 rash/skin-drug reaction: permanently discontinue capivasertib.

action.message: Recurrent intolerable grade≥3 rash: consider permanent capivasertib discontinuation. This is a Consultant choice in the source, not an automatic permanent-stop rule; current grade 3 still requires interruption.

rules.explanation: Recurrent intolerable grade≥3 rash: consider permanent capivasertib discontinuation. This is a Consultant choice in the source, not an automatic permanent-stop rule; current grade 3 still requires interruption.

action.message: Suspected severe skin-drug reaction (blistering/mucosal lesions/peeling): interrupt pending urgent clinical/dermatology assessment and determine severity. Do not downgrade severe features because an overall grade has not been entered.

rules.explanation: Suspected severe skin-drug reaction (blistering/mucosal lesions/peeling): interrupt pending urgent clinical/dermatology assessment and determine severity. Do not downgrade severe features because an overall grade has not been entered.

action.message: Restart after diarrhoea requires the current event grade and recovery course; missing results do not authorise treatment.

rules.explanation: Restart after diarrhoea requires the current event grade and recovery course; missing results do not authorise treatment.

action.message: Prior grade 3 diarrhoea recovered tograde≤1 within 28 days: restart one level below the actual pre-interruption capivasertib dose after Consultant review; do not escalate or invent a level below200 mg twice daily.

rules.explanation: Prior grade 3 diarrhoea recovered tograde≤1 within 28 days: restart one level below the actual pre-interruption capivasertib dose after Consultant review; do not escalate or invent a level below200 mg twice daily.

action.message: Prior grade 3 diarrhoea has not recovered tograde≤1 within 28 days: permanently discontinue capivasertib as specified in the source.

rules.explanation: Prior grade 3 diarrhoea has not recovered tograde≤1 within 28 days: permanently discontinue capivasertib as specified in the source.

action.message: Prior grade 3 diarrhoea did not recover within 28 days; the printed source requires capivasertib discontinuation even if recovery is recorded later.

rules.explanation: Prior grade 3 diarrhoea did not recover within 28 days; the printed source requires capivasertib discontinuation even if recovery is recorded later.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP00947p8 capivasertib minimal-to-low oral risk; local policy. No routine premedication.
summary: No routine premedication. Consider secondary diarrhoea or rash prophylaxis for recurrent/persistent problems.
At first diarrhoea, agreed loperamide4mg then2mg after each loose stool, maximum16mg/day; hydration and urgent advice for severe symptoms.
Individual diabetes plan and glucose monitoring are essential, including on/off-treatment days.
